Name: Candace
Dialog: It's totally time for a totally favorite TV show! (offering Jeremy a seat when he arrives) Hey, Jeremy. Care to have a seat? Ehehe I have something to show you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (mysterious voice) It's impossibly important...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ohh, it's starting! (put finger to Jeremy's lips) Shhhh...

Name: Robbie Wyckoff
Dialog: Oh yeah...

Name: Robbie Wyckoff
Dialog: Everybody get up, time to shimmy and shake!

Name: Robbie Wyckoff
Dialog: Stomp and twist 'til your ankles break!

Name: Robbie Wyckoff
Dialog: Jumpin' all around like a pogo stick!

Name: Robbie Wyckoff
Dialog: Let's all dance until we're sick!

Name: Robbie Wyckoff
Dialog: Let's all dance until we're sick!

Name: Nikki
Dialog: Hi ya! Nikki Stars here. Get ready Danville! This week, the world's most popular dance contest is coming to you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See Jeremy, that's my surprise. They're taping here in Danville and I've already entered us!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: No way! You guys are totally gonna win!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sure, Candace! Um.. I'm gonna go get some fresh air, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay! (to Stacy) He's so excited he can't breathe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, brother of mine, what endeavor shall we engage in today? (To Jeremy) Hey, Jeremy, what's the haps, big guy?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, man. Your sister's entered us in some big dance show. And, you know, I just don't wanna let her down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what's the problem?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Have you seen the fancy dancing on the show? I can fake it in the school auditorium. Just not on a nationally syndicated dance show.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, maybe Ferb can teach you.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow. That's really-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (interrupting) Uhp-uhp! Wait for it...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: There's no way I can learn that by tonight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmmm...maybe you don't have to. (to Ferb) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! (a short pause) What? (short pause starts again) Oh. Sorry. (grabs Ferb's hand and pulls him up) Hey! I wonder where Perry is!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. It seems Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying up the entire Tri-State Area's supply of potatoes, bacon, and whole boatloads of chopped green onions- sounds like a recipe for evil, literally. So uh, get cooking Agent P! Monogram out.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, here it is! The Ferbalistic Groovatron 9000!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: How is that supposed to help me?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You put it on under your clothes, and nobody will see this electronic exoskeleton helping you with dance moves!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb does a fancy dancing move over here, and you do the same fancy move over there!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sweet.

Name: Computer voice
Dialog: Intruder alert.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, well, well, look who's here. Perry the Platypus. All shackled up and no place to go! Uh, I think we made too much potato salad, Norm. I-I guess we'll have to give everyone a 2-ton take-home container. And I still think you should have added more green onions.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Well, next time you can do all the cooking, and I'll stand around coming up with evil plans that ultimately fail!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (stares at him) Wow. Cuttin' deep, man. Well, I'm off to our annual evil potluck and press conference. I'll just leave you here to, you know, meet your doom. Look, I saw this in a movie once. I didn't catch the ending, because I had other things to do, but I-it seemed pretty foolproof. Well, gotta run! Can't be in two places at the same time, but of course, soon you'll be able to! (turning to Norm) Norm, let's go.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Would it kill you to say please once in a while?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Are you going to be like this all day?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We are so going to win this thing, Jeremy. We are going TO WIN!

Name: Nikki
Dialog: Dancers, your dance floor awaits!

Name: Nikki
Dialog: Our dancers will boogie until they get axed by the judges. If your light goes out, your time is up. Now, let the dancing begin!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready?

Name: Evil Scientist #1
Dialog: Alright Heinz, where's the press?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Patience, Dr. Bloodpudding, they'll be here. When have I ever let you guys down?

Name: Evil Scientist #2
Dialog: Far too often Doofenshmirtz, far too often.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Rodney, I don't remember inviting you.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: I told you! I prefer you use my full name

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, today is the day we reveal to the Tri-State Area, the existence of the League Of Villainous Evildoers Maniacally United For Frightening Investments in Naughtiness!

Name: Dr. Bloodpudding
Dialog: You want us to be called L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, good grief!! It doesn't matter what we're called. What's important is that we get our evil message out to the people of the Tri-State Area!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: And how are we going to that with no TV cameras or no press of any kind?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They'll be here, they'll be here.  Clearly, the buffet alone will bring them.

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yummy, yummy potato salad!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: And we do seem to have a surplus of that. (Grins mockingly) Did you expect everyone to lug home 2-ton take home bags?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No.

Name: Norm
Dialog: (suddenly) Yes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shut it, Norm. Whose side are you on, anyway? And the press will be here, Rodney.

Name: Evil Scientist #3
Dialog: I don't think so, Heinz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dr. Diminutive?

Name: Dr. Diminutive
Dialog: Here, look. All the press in town is covering this.

Name: News broadcaster
Dialog: That's right. Let's Dance 'Til We're Sick is filming here in Danville. And I've got all the live coverage 24/7!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh. Well, if the press won't come to us, we'll go to the press. To the dance hall!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Attention, miserable citizens of Danville!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He-Hello? Evil scientist speaking! Can-Can I get a camera over here? What? Nothing? Why are they so focused on these dancers?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Because it's a dance contest, Heinz. Clearly, they're only filming the best dancers!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hm. Wait! That's it! Okay. Split up and start dancing like you've never danced before! Whoever gets on camera first can deliver our message of evil!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: They're terrible!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ahh! The humanity!!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: This looks like a job for Aloyse Everheart Elizabeth-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, can it, Rodney. I think we both know that I'm a better evil dancer than you.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (Holds up his hand in Doofenshmirtz' face) See this? It's my hand. You can talk to it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See you on the dance floor!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Nobody talks to my hand that way!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (via Perry's wristwatch communicator) Agent P, you must stop Doofenshmirtz and his unnamed gang of evil scientists before they broadcast their message of evil, and interrupt what has quickly become mine and Carl's favorite show.

Name: Nikki
Dialog: Well, this shindig is in full swing! Looks like the judges are starting to eliminate dancers, who will survive?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, they're eliminating people. Let's kick it up a notch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: People of the Tri-State Area, you may begin quaking in fear at your earliest possible convenience- (Doofenshmirtz's light goes out) Wait, really? Were-Were you even watching that move?

Name: Rodney
Dialog: (while doing his ballet) Hello, my future subjects, it is I, Aloyse Everheart Elizabeth- (Rodney's light goes out) Pearls before swine...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I represent the League Of Villainous Evildoers Maniacally United For Frightening Investments- (Doof's light goes out) Ah! Philistine! That-That was a perfectly good Charleston!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa! You are r-e-e-e-e-e-e-e-a-l-l-l-l-l-y good!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Bravo! Bravo! (tosses a bouquet of flowers) Go, Candace!

Name: Random guy
Dialog: Oh man, that guy is awesome!

Name: Nikki
Dialog: Looks like someone's a fan favorite.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Hello again, my- (Light goes out) Oh!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Enough members to fill the Danville Arena were eliminated using really painful moves, which sends them to the intensive care system.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, that's my spotlight! If anyone's pushing this dancer out of the way, it's me!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Oh no, Doofenshmirtz, I was here first!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Goes face-to-face directly with Rodney) Am I gonna have to talk to your hand again?!?!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Maybe in your own mind!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: No! Mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is awkward.

Name: Nikki
Dialog: And look! There's only one dancer left standing! Let's see what he does.

Name: Nikki
Dialog: (while the audience applaud for Jeremy) Say, that was some fabulicious dancing out there! I see quite a future for someone with moves like that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is she saying what I think she's saying?

Name: Nikki
Dialog: How'd you like to dance 'til you're sick every week?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do it, Jeremy, do it! We could be stars! Dancing stars! We can-

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I can't do this. All those great dance moves I've been doing today? Well, it was actually...

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's kind of disturbing.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It was this crazy contraption doing all those dance moves. If you wanna see what a real dancer looks like, then here you go!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, it looks like my work here is done.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But I'm sorry about all this, Candace. I-I just didn't want to let you down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy. You weren't gonna let me down. I just wanted you to come out with me and have a good time! And you know, dance 'til we're sick!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, I am feeling a little dizzy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got 'ya, big guy. (They leave the studio)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in the intensive care system) They should have called it "Let's All Dance Til We're In Intensive Care".

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow!
